function: CSI prediction: forecasts future compressed CSI from historical compressed CSI at the base station, then a decoder reconstructs the channel matrix (p. 2).
system: Massive MIMO OFDM downlink: BS with 8x2 dual-polarized panel array (Nt=32), single-antenna UE, 32 subcarriers, 20 MHz; no RIS; carrier frequency not stated (pp. 2-3).
method: STEM GNN (self-attention graph learning, GFT and DFT, 1D-Conv with GLU, graph convolution), trained by loss minimization on historical compressed CSI; supervised, implied (pp. 3, 5).
data_channel: Simulated 3GPP 3D channel model, Urban Macro scenario, 10,000 consecutive timestamps, 3 km/h user speed; no measured data, no public dataset; train/test split not described (pp. 2-3).
test_conditions: One scenario only (UMa, 3 km/h, [8,2,2] antennas); no unseen scenario; sweeps over SNR, horizon P=3 to 9, compression ratio 1/16 to 1/4, window fixed at K=12 (pp. 3-4).
baselines: Learned only: RNN and LSTM CSI predictors implemented by the authors; STNet compresses CSI for all models; no non-learned predictor (for example autoregressive) is compared (pp. 2-4).
metrics: Spectral efficiency (sum rate, bps/Hz) with ZF precoding versus SNR; RMSE of predicted CSI; NMSE of reconstructed CSI; training loss versus epochs (pp. 4-5).
complexity: none; only the GPU used (Nvidia RTX 3060) and training-loss convergence are given, no operations, parameters or runtime (pp. 4-5).
openness: Code released at https://github.com/sharanmourya/CSI-Prediction/ (footnote 1, p. 4); no dataset link given.
q1_support: p. 3: "simulations using the 3GPP channel model" - p. 2 says the 3D channel conforms to 3GPP specifications for 5G and Table I (p. 3) gives the Urban Macro (UMa) scenario; TR 38.901 is not named by number.
q2_support: p. 3: "Urban Macro (UMa)" - the only scenario (Table I, 3Kmph, [8, 2, 2] antennas); results only sweep SNR, horizon P and compression ratio; no unseen scenario, speed, antenna configuration or dataset is tested.
q3_support: p. 3: "we compare our approach with RNN and LSTM-based CSI prediction models" - only learned baselines; Figs. 3 to 6 (pp. 4-5) plot STEM, LSTM and RNN only, with no non-learned predictor.
q4_support: p. 5: "converges significantly faster than that of RNN and LSTM" - only training convergence and the GPU model (p. 4) are given; no complexity order, operations, parameters or runtime.
q5_support: p. 4: "https://github.com/sharanmourya/" - footnote 1 gives this link, repository CSI-Prediction, as the source code of this paper (the text extraction scrambles the footnote word order).
notes: Read in full from the PDF text (pp. 1-5) and the figure pages (pp. 3-5). The PDF is the arXiv:2312.02159v1 preprint 'Spectral Temporal Graph Neural Network for massive MIMO CSI Prediction' (p. 1); it prints no DOI, so the DOI-PDF match rests on topic and letter format. q1: the paper cites the 3GPP 5G 3D UMa channel (pp. 2-3) without the TR 38.901 number; reviewer to confirm. CSI compression with STNet is borrowed; the learned function graded is the prediction. Main metrics are sum rate, RMSE and NMSE, so area 2.
